digest.component_or_area: RP-02 through RP-06 janitor derisk and approval; BindingStore, outbound lifecycle, operation composition, CLI registry, plan-review routing
propositions: Recovered RP-02 through RP-06 approval decisions from 2026-08-16 janitor plan require evidence-backed derisk research to preserve architectural intent, hard-won behaviors, and resolve implementation-critical ambiguities before becoming stories.

RP-02 transaction semantics must achieve ordered exact-match retirement recovery at explicit live-operation boundary: durable tombstone is retirement intent, recovery removes live pair only when identities exactly agree, repeat is no-op, ambiguity aborts.

RP-03 owns TicketPlan orchestration and Jira failure scopes with singular retry ownership: adapter owns physical request-replay loop and native error decoding; reconciler owns operation intent, commit_unknown, re-observation, and scoped finite-pass fuse.

RP-04 must preserve explicit precedence (CLI > environment > project > user > default), per-operation snapshot, separate secret/provider boundary, and name behavior deltas including CLI-over-environment correction and removal of Cloud adapter fallback.
RP-05 lazy registry/capability boundary must decide whether to normalize all 21 advanced verbs onto side-effect-free help now or preserve current two-family help policy.

RP-06 effective applicability reversal and effective built-in/project-DET routing are settled; must decide parity-first current-run failure projection or normalize blocking-capable coverage gaps; failed/cancelled/shed units never become success checkpoints.
